stream_schedule.selection: sort all complete C8 documents by sha256(order_seed, domain, text_sha256), then take the longest prefix whose next document would not exceed the nominal phase byte budget
stream_schedule.phase_overlap: phase 1 and phase 3 are independently ordered views of C8 and may overlap; every arm sees the exact same frozen view within a phase

phase1.reference: nearest integer to v11 historical 16M-token exposure divided by 0.2978 tokens/raw-byte

phase3.reference: nearest integer to v11 historical 8M-token exposure divided by 0.2978 tokens/raw-byte

evaluation.selection: all 200 frozen C3 documents sorted by sha256(evaluation_order_seed, domain, text_sha256)

optimization.learning_rate_schedule: linear warmup over first 2% of phase raw bytes, then cosine decay to 10% of phase peak LR; progress is cumulative complete-document UTF-8 bytes
optimization.phase3_transition: reinitialize attention projection matrices from the paired phase3 seed; preserve learned embeddings, norms, and FFNs; freeze only all FFN matrices and each layer's FFN norm

checkpoints.evaluation_time_accounting: held-out evaluation time is recorded separately and excluded from training wall-clock interpolation

accounting.active_row_rule: embedding/output row is active if its token ID occurs in the phase stream; non-row trunk parameters are active when their module executes

statistics.primary_endpoint: phase3 held-out corpus BPB under fixed_total, averaged across paired run labels 0, 1, and 2
statistics.secondary_endpoint: phase3 held-out corpus BPB under fixed_trunk
statistics.training_run_interval: two-sided 90% Student-t interval over the three paired BPB differences, df=2, explicitly caveated
statistics.unresolved_rule: inconsistent paired-difference signs or an interval crossing zero is unresolved

execution.launch_policy: validate and register all cells before launch; this freeze operation must not start expensive training
